classification_check.name: Adaptability
classification_check.note: Exact label in a different source category. Check whether the intended sense is a work style or a distinct ability.

definition: Adaptability is the capacity to adjust one's methods or behavior when requirements, circumstances, or available information change.
label: Adaptability

classification_check.name: Attention to Detail
classification_check.note: Exact label in a different source category. Check whether the intended sense is a work style or a distinct ability.

definition: Attention to detail is the capacity to notice and verify small elements whose omission or inconsistency could affect the result.
label: Attention to detail

definition: Emotional stability is a tendency to maintain relatively steady emotional responses and recover composure under stress.
label: Emotional stability
sense_note: Better understood as a disposition than as a discrete cognitive ability.

definition: Being goal-oriented is a tendency to organize and prioritize work around a specified objective.
label: Goal-oriented
sense_note: The adjectival label describes a work orientation.

definition: Being results-oriented is a tendency to judge work by its demonstrated outcomes rather than by activity alone.
label: Results-oriented
sense_note: The adjectival label describes a work orientation.

classification_check.name: Self-Confidence
classification_check.note: Exact label in a different source category. Check whether the intended sense is a work style or a distinct ability.

definition: Self-confidence is trust in one's capacity to act or exercise judgment in a situation, without implying that the judgment is correct.
label: Self-confidence
sense_note: Better understood as a disposition or belief than as a discrete cognitive ability.

definition: A self-starter identifies and begins useful work without needing detailed instructions or repeated prompting.
label: Self-starter
sense_note: The label names a person characterized by initiative.

definition: Being success-driven is a tendency to seek achievement and persist in pursuit of a high standard of performance.
label: Success-driven
sense_note: The label describes motivation rather than a discrete ability.

definition: Being team-oriented is a tendency to coordinate one's contributions with others in support of shared goals.
label: Team-oriented
sense_note: The adjectival label describes a work orientation.

definition: Actuarial exams are professional assessments of quantitative and business knowledge required along actuarial credentialing pathways.
label: Actuarial exams
sense_note: The label names examinations, not a field of knowledge.

definition: An application pool groups web applications under shared worker-process settings and isolates their execution from applications in separate pools.
label: Application pool
sense_note: The usual sense is Microsoft's IIS hosting concept.

definition: ARP4754 is an SAE aerospace recommended practice for developing civil aircraft and systems using structured requirements, validation, verification, and development assurance.
label: ARP4754
sense_note: Specific revisions have different designations; the label does not specify one.

definition: Athletic training is a health profession focused on preventing, evaluating, managing, and rehabilitating injuries and conditions associated with physical activity.
label: Athletic training
sense_note: Distinguish the health profession from athletic performance conditioning.

definition: Attorney-client privilege is a legal protection against compelled disclosure of qualifying confidential communications between a lawyer and a client for the purpose of obtaining or giving legal advice.
label: Attorney-client privilege
sense_note: Scope and exceptions vary by jurisdiction; not all attorney communications are privileged.

definition: Authorised capital is the maximum amount of share capital a company is permitted to issue under its governing documents or applicable legal framework.
label: Authorised capital
sense_note: Terms and requirements vary by jurisdiction.

definition: Cognitive computing is a broad label for computer systems designed to support or approximate human capabilities such as interpreting language, recognizing patterns, and reasoning from evidence.
label: Cognitive computing
sense_note: The label is used inconsistently and does not imply consciousness or a single technical architecture.

definition: Cross-domain solutions control authorized information access or transfer between security domains with different trust levels or policies.
label: Cross-domain solutions
sense_note: Interpreted as the information-security term; outside that context the phrase can mean any solution spanning disciplines.

definition: The cross product of two vectors in three-dimensional Euclidean space is a vector perpendicular to both, oriented by the right-hand rule and with magnitude equal to the area they span.
label: Cross product
sense_note: Interpreted as the vector operation; some fields use the phrase informally for a Cartesian product.

definition: Custom post types are developer-defined WordPress content categories with their own names and configured editing, display, or routing behavior.
label: Custom post types
sense_note: The phrase is specifically associated with WordPress; a post type is not the same as a taxonomy term.

definition: Data localization is a requirement to store, process, or retain specified data within a designated jurisdiction, depending on the applicable rule.
label: Data localization
sense_note: Localization requirements vary and are not synonymous with choosing where data resides.

definition: Dot matrix printing uses arrays of dots to form text and graphics, usually through pins striking an inked ribbon against paper.
label: Dot matrix printing
sense_note: Interpreted as the familiar impact printer technology.

definition: A dynamic-link library contains code or other resources that a program can link to or load at runtime rather than incorporating them into its own executable at build time.
label: Dynamic-link library
sense_note: The term DLL is especially associated with Windows; shared libraries serve similar purposes on other platforms.

definition: Excess return is the difference between an investment's return and a specified reference return.
label: Excess return
sense_note: The comparator can be a benchmark, risk-free rate or another specified reference.

definition: An extended validation certificate is a public-key certificate issued after a certificate authority performs prescribed checks on an organization's identity.
label: Extended validation certificate
sense_note: Browser presentation varies; it does not establish that the site is safe.

definition: A file control block is a data structure that holds the metadata an operating system uses to manage a file.
label: File control block
sense_note: The specific fields and purpose differ across operating systems.

definition: A mechanic's lien is a statutory claim against property that can secure payment for qualifying work or materials supplied to improve it.
label: Mechanic's lien
sense_note: Requirements and terminology vary by jurisdiction.

definition: Medical devices are instruments, equipment, implants or software intended for a medical purpose such as diagnosis, monitoring or treatment.
label: Medical devices
sense_note: Formal regulatory definitions vary by jurisdiction.

definition: The metaverse is a broad concept for persistent, shared digital spaces where people interact, often through avatars.
label: Metaverse
sense_note: The label has no single settled technical definition.

definition: Mixed reality combines digital content with a view of the physical surroundings so that virtual objects can be positioned in, and may respond to, the real environment.
label: Mixed reality
sense_note: The boundary between mixed and augmented reality varies across sources.

definition: Naked short selling is selling a security short without first borrowing it or arranging to borrow it for delivery.
label: Naked short selling
sense_note: Legal definitions and exceptions vary by jurisdiction.

definition: Net zero describes a balance between greenhouse gas emissions and removals within specified boundaries and a defined period.
label: Net zero
sense_note: Some targets cover carbon dioxide alone rather than all greenhouse gases.

definition: A non-fungible token is a uniquely identified digital token recorded on a ledger rather than treated as interchangeable with another token of the same type.
label: Non-fungible tokens
sense_note: A token does not automatically confer ownership of a referenced work or its copyright.

definition: Nutraceuticals are foods, food components or related products promoted for health benefits beyond basic nutrition.
label: Nutraceuticals
sense_note: The term is not a uniform regulatory category and does not establish efficacy.

definition: Open banking allows authorized third parties to access banking data or initiate supported services through secure, customer-consented interfaces.
label: Open banking
sense_note: The permitted services and consent requirements depend on the framework.

definition: Personal Communications Service refers to mobile wireless voice and data services designated as PCS in telecommunications regulation.
label: Personal Communications Service
sense_note: The frequencies and regulatory scope depend on jurisdiction.

definition: Pharmacoinformatics applies computational and information methods to data about drugs and their discovery, use or effects.
label: Pharmacoinformatics
sense_note: Usage spans drug-discovery and clinical-information contexts.

definition: Prisoners' rights are legal protections that people retain while incarcerated.
label: Prisoners' rights
sense_note: Specific protections and remedies depend on jurisdiction.

definition: A PTAS reduction transforms an optimization problem to another so that a polynomial-time approximation scheme for the latter yields one for the former.
label: PTAS reduction
sense_note: Formal definitions and notation vary; the key property is preservation of approximation-scheme existence.

definition: A quartile is one of three cut points dividing ordered data into four parts based on cumulative proportion.
label: Quartile
sense_note: Sample calculation conventions differ.

definition: A reference range is an interval of laboratory values established for a defined reference population using a specified test method.
label: Reference range
sense_note: A reference range is not necessarily a diagnostic or treatment threshold.

definition: Rehabilitation supports people in improving or maintaining function and participation after injury, illness or another change in capacity.
label: Rehabilitation
sense_note: The label can also refer to legal, social or environmental restoration; the health sense is used here.

definition: Risk ratings classify assessed risk into numerical scores or categories using specified criteria.
label: Risk ratings
sense_note: Criteria depend on the domain and rating scheme.

definition: A social impact bond is an outcomes-based financing arrangement in which private or philanthropic investors fund a service and repayment depends on agreed results.
label: Social impact bond
sense_note: Despite the name, it need not be a conventional tradable bond.

definition: A sovereign cloud is a cloud offering designed to satisfy specified sovereignty constraints on data, operations and legal jurisdiction.
label: Sovereign cloud
sense_note: Requirements differ by jurisdiction and procurement context.

definition: Standard ambient temperature and pressure is a reference condition commonly specified as 25 degrees Celsius and 100 kilopascals.
label: Standard ambient temperature and pressure
sense_note: Check the stated convention, especially when comparing it with STP or other reference conditions.

definition: A sustainability bond is debt whose proceeds fund eligible projects combining environmental and social objectives.
label: Sustainability bond
sense_note: Distinguish from a sustainability-linked bond, whose financial terms are tied to performance targets.

definition: A tax shelter is an investment or arrangement intended to reduce or defer tax liability.
label: Tax shelter
sense_note: The term covers arrangements with differing legal status.

definition: Use of force concerns the application of physical compulsion and the legal, ethical and organizational standards that govern it.
label: Use of force
sense_note: The relevant standards depend on the setting and jurisdiction.

definition: Yahoo! Messenger protocols were communication formats and rules used by the Yahoo! Messenger service to exchange messages and status information.
label: Yahoo! Messenger protocols
sense_note: Historical implementations differed by client and protocol version.

definition: AngularJS is the original JavaScript-based Angular framework that links HTML templates to application data and behavior through directives and binding.

definition: Apple Device Enrollment Program was an Apple service for automating institutional enrollment of eligible devices into mobile device management.

definition: Architectural visualization communicates built-environment designs through representations such as images, diagrams, walkthroughs, or interactive models.

sense_note: This broader practice includes rendering rather than being identical to it.

definition: ASP.NET Identity is a Microsoft framework for adding user accounts, authentication, and related identity features to ASP.NET applications.
label: ASP.NET Identity
sense_note: Clarify whether the historical ASP.NET or ASP.NET Core identity implementation is required.

definition: ASP.NET Web API is a .NET framework for building HTTP services, especially APIs accessed by clients beyond web browsers.
label: ASP.NET Web API
sense_note: The label can refer specifically to the earlier framework rather than ASP.NET Core web APIs.

definition: Autism therapy encompasses individualized clinical or developmental supports intended to help autistic people pursue communication, daily living, or other chosen goals.
label: Autism therapy
sense_note: This is an umbrella term, not one treatment, and does not imply a goal of eliminating autism.

definition: Autoshade was an Autodesk rendering application for producing shaded images from three-dimensional AutoCAD geometry.
label: Autoshade
sense_note: The suggested sense is the historical Autodesk renderer.

definition: AWS big data refers to the use of Amazon Web Services to ingest, store, process, and analyze large or complex datasets.
label: AWS big data
sense_note: This is a service area rather than a single AWS product.

definition: Azure Security refers to protecting Azure workloads and data through identity, network, configuration, and monitoring controls.
label: Azure Security
sense_note: This is a broad practice, not necessarily a single Microsoft product.

definition: The Baseline Personnel Security Standard is a UK government framework for basic employment screening of individuals with access to government assets.
label: Baseline Personnel Security Standard
sense_note: This is a baseline screening framework, not a national security clearance.

definition: Blender Game Engine was Blender’s integrated runtime and authoring environment for interactive 3D experiences.
label: Blender Game Engine
sense_note: The historical Blender component is distinct from later forks and unrelated engines.

definition: Box Backup is software for backing up files to a remote server and restoring them later.
label: Box Backup
sense_note: This is the backup tool named Box Backup, not a general reference to backups in the Box cloud platform.

definition: C-CURE is a physical security platform for access control and monitoring security events in buildings.
label: C-CURE
sense_note: The name can refer to several related product generations.

definition: Caffe2 is a deep-learning framework designed to run neural-network training or inference workloads across different deployment environments.
label: Caffe2
sense_note: This is a separate framework from the original Caffe.

definition: Cakewalk is a digital audio workstation lineage for recording, arranging, editing, and mixing music.
label: Cakewalk
sense_note: The label could also refer to a software publisher or historical products under that name.

definition: CanCan was a Ruby on Rails authorization library for defining what actions users may perform on application resources.
label: CanCan
sense_note: The later maintained fork is CanCanCan; do not assume the label refers to that fork.

definition: Cerner refers to a family of healthcare information systems, including electronic health record products.
label: Cerner
sense_note: The name can refer to the vendor or different products, so a specific application may need clarification.

definition: A chronometer is a precision timekeeping instrument, traditionally associated with navigation or certified accuracy.
label: Chronometer

sense_note: Interpreted as the Scala library, not the thermal injury or processing technique.

definition: A screen reader presents software and document content through synthesized speech or a refreshable braille display using accessible interface information.
label: Screen reader
sense_note: Assistive technology rather than an ability in itself.

definition: Script writing creates the action, dialogue, narration, or instructions that guide a staged or recorded production.
label: Script writing
sense_note: Could denote writing software scripts in a computing context; interpreted as media writing.

definition: Security management establishes responsibilities, policies, and controls for protecting people, assets, or information against identified threats.
label: Security management
sense_note: Broad term with physical, organizational, and information security senses.

label: Seeder
sense_note: Ambiguous among agricultural planting equipment, software database seed utilities, peer-to-peer file uploaders, and other senses; identify the intended referent.

sense_proposal.ambiguity_note: Distinct candidates include a database initialization class or utility, agricultural machinery that places seed, and a peer sharing a complete file. The tool hint does not choose between software and machinery, and the peer sense names a role rather than a tool. Require source context or an identifiable product before defining.
sense_proposal.label: Seeder

definition: Segment is a customer data platform for collecting and routing event and profile data to other applications.
label: Segment (software)
sense_note: Interpreted as the Segment customer data product.

definition: Selenium is a collection of tools for automating web browser interactions, often for testing web applications.
label: Selenium
sense_note: Interpreted as browser automation software, not the element.

definition: Sequel Pro is a macOS graphical client for managing and querying MySQL databases.
label: Sequel Pro
sense_note: Legacy application; distinguish it from successor projects.

definition: ServiceNow is a cloud software platform for managing workflows such as service requests, incidents, and organizational approvals.
label: ServiceNow
sense_note: The label identifies a platform rather than a specific module.

definition: Shared Vision Planning combines participation, collaborative computer modeling, and water resources planning to help stakeholders compare management alternatives.

definition: Sharp Zaurus was a family of handheld personal digital assistants, including models capable of running Linux.

definition: Shuttle car operation is the controlled use of a mobile underground mining vehicle that carries material between extraction and transfer points.

definition: The Simputer was a low-cost handheld computing design created in India to make computing more accessible through features such as shared use and support for local-language interfaces.
label: Simputer

definition: Skip tracing is the lawful search for a person's current location or contact information when previously available information no longer reaches them.
label: Skip tracing

definition: A smart pig is an instrumented device that travels through a pipeline to collect inspection data about its internal condition or geometry.

definition: SmartBidNet is construction bid-management software for distributing invitations, managing subcontractor contacts, and tracking bids.

definition: Snow Software provides tools for software asset and technology management, including inventory, license reconciliation, and usage reporting.
label: Snow Software

definition: Soil fertility treatment adjusts nutrient availability or soil conditions to support plant growth based on the crop and soil's needs.
label: Soil fertility treatment

definition: A solar panel is an assembly that collects solar energy, commonly using photovoltaic cells to produce electricity or a thermal collector to provide heat.

definition: SonicWall provides network security products including firewalls and related tools for controlling and monitoring network traffic.

definition: Spine.js is a JavaScript framework for structuring web application models and controllers and managing client-side application behavior.

definition: A spray gun applies a substance by dispersing it into droplets and directing the spray onto a target surface.

definition: SPServices is a legacy jQuery library for calling SharePoint SOAP web services from browser scripts.
label: SPServices
sense_note: Legacy library; verify product context.

definition: Spyder is a Python development environment designed for scientific computing, with an editor, interactive console, and variable inspection tools.

definition: Statement on Auditing Standards No. 70 was a U.S. auditing standard for reporting on controls at service organizations relevant to their customers' financial reporting.

definition: A structure chart diagrams the hierarchy of software modules and their calling or data relationships.
label: Structure chart

definition: Student's t-test uses a t statistic to test a hypothesis about a mean or mean difference under specified assumptions.

definition: The Stuttgart Neural Network Simulator is a software package for constructing, training, and studying artificial neural networks.
label: Stuttgart Neural Network Simulator

definition: Substance use assessment evaluates patterns, risks, consequences, and related needs to guide professional decisions about support or treatment.

definition: Sybase Unwired Platform was middleware for developing and managing enterprise mobile applications connected to back-end systems.

definition: Syskey was a legacy Windows utility for configuring additional protection of account database keys at system startup.

definition: Sysomos was a social media analysis and management platform used to track mentions, trends, and audience activity.

definition: Systems management administers and monitors computing infrastructure, including configuration, updates, inventory, and availability.

definition: Tableau is a visual analytics platform for connecting to data and creating interactive charts, dashboards, and reports.

definition: A tape recorder captures audio by magnetically recording it on moving tape and can reproduce the recorded signal during playback.

definition: Tekla is Trimble's family of structural design, analysis, modeling, and detailing applications.
label: Tekla

definition: Television programming selects, schedules, or commissions content for a television channel or service to meet audience and operational goals.

definition: Temporal is a platform for durable application workflows that records execution history and coordinates work, retries, and recovery across failures.

definition: Theano was an open-source Python library for defining and optimizing mathematical expressions on multidimensional arrays, including automatic differentiation.

definition: Therapeutic interventions are planned actions intended to alleviate symptoms, improve functioning, or support recovery in a care context.

definition: TIBCO ActiveMatrix is a suite of enterprise middleware products for integrating applications and building, deploying, or managing services and processes.

definition: TIBCO Designer is a graphical development environment used in legacy TIBCO products to configure integration resources and processes.
label: TIBCO Designer

definition: The Time Protocol is a simple network protocol that returns a binary count of seconds since the beginning of 1900 for time retrieval.
label: Time Protocol

definition: TinyDB is a lightweight Python document database that commonly stores records in a local JSON file.
label: TinyDB

definition: TokuDB was a MySQL-compatible storage engine designed for high insertion rates using fractal tree indexes and compression.

definition: Toon Boom is a family of animation and storyboard software used to plan and produce digital animated productions.

definition: Torch is an older Lua-based scientific computing and machine learning framework with tensor and neural network libraries.

definition: Track and trace records the identity, movement, and history of items or consignments so their current state and prior locations can be established.

definition: Treatment planning translates findings and patient goals into a proposed sequence of care actions, monitoring, and reassessment.

definition: Unisys MAPPER is a legacy data management and application development environment for interactive reporting and business applications.
